description: Prepare or revise an editable design: enclosure (PCB base and lid), workholding (nests, fixtures, soft jaws), gripper (compliant TPU pad kits) or stamping (matched dies). Pass that workbench's inputs at the top level: enclosure {parameters or kicadPcb, quantity}; workholding {parameters, quantity, stlBase64, stlUnits}; gripper {configuration}; stamping {parameters, sheet, quantity, materialId, productionSpeed, fulfillmentMethod}. Call get_workbench_capabilities with workbench for field constraints if you don't have them. Returns the normalized design, revision, warnings and a private review link. Uses no quote allowance.

accessToken.description: Guest token from printing.sessions.start, unless Authorization carries one.

name: workbench.prepare

build.description: Complete-set quote and authoritative server totals, returned after quoting.

reviewUrl.description: Private design review link for the customer.

revision.description: Hash of the exact normalized design and quantity.

warnings.description: Design and manufacturing limitations to review.

title: Prepare Workbench Design
